defects.title: User creation accepts a duplicate email despite the uniqueness rule
steps: Create a user with email alice@example.com
Create a second user with the same email
defects.expected: 409 Conflict and no second user created (business rule BR-004, email uniqueness)
defects.actual: 201 Created and a second user record exists with the same email
defects.severity_rationale: Duplicate accounts corrupt identity data and break password reset for the affected customers
